bt.title: Ikhophi yedijitali
bt.note: Ukwakheka kuvela eselini elilungile elingezansi noma efayelini lokwakheka elenziwe ku-Material flow. Igcinwa kulelifayela le-IFC, futhi izinto zidwetshwa embonweni we-3D endaweni onikeza lapha.
bt.nomodel: Vula imodeli ye-IFC kuqala: ukwakheka kugcinwa efayelini lemodeli.
bt.fit.nolayout: Akukho kwakheka okuhlolwayo okwamanje. Sebenzisa iselo noma vula ifayela lokwakheka.
bt.fit.nolevel: Imodeli ayinalo izinga lokubeka ukwakheka kulo.
bt.fit.problems: Ukwakheka akusakhiwa okwamanje ({list}), ngakho akukwazi ukuhlolwa.
bt.fit.touch: {n} izinto zithinta udonga ezingeni {level}: {items}. Ihlolwe ngokumelene nezindonga, inani: {walls}.
bt.fit.clear: Akukho sinto esithinta izindonga ezingeni {level}. Izinto: {items}. Izindonga: {walls}.
bt.fit.note: Lokhu kubheka amabhokisi ezinto ngokumelene nezinqe zezindonga, ebhulukwini nasebude. Iminyango namawindi akubhekwa, futhi umzila wokugeleza awazi ngezindonga.
bt.carries: Imodeli yesakhiwo iphethe amakamelo, izindonga nezinga, hhayi ukuthi imishini iziphatha kanjani: isivinini, izikhathi kanye nengqondo yokulawula kubekwa ekwakhekeni nasepanele elingezansi. Lapha akukho ukuhlolwa kokuphepha.
